column3: Close to the Greek; “Booths” is rendered “Tabernacles.”
NKJV has “I am not yet going up,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “I am not going up.”
NKJV places “to the feast” with Jesus going up; the Greek attaches it to the brothers' going up.
Close to the Greek; “murmuring” is rendered “complaining.”
Close to the Greek; “teaching” is rendered “doctrine.”
NKJV has “truly the Christ,” following the Textus Receptus, which repeats “truly”; the critical text has “that this is the Christ.”
